title: 公司债供应创纪录：贝森特收益率上限，能奏效？
speaker: Danielle DiMartino Booth

segments.en: There is a ton of corporate bond market supply coming online record levels here and in the months to come throughout the end of the year.
segments.zh: 大量公司债市场供应即将上线，创纪录水平，未来几个月乃至年底都是如此。

segments.en: And the term premium is sky high as you note.
segments.zh: 正如你所指出的，期限溢价非常高。

segments.en: So whether or not this is going to be effective, we will find out purchases don't begin until September the 9th and whether or not Bessense has backed himself into a corner where he has to go from $2 billion to $4 billion a month to potentially $8 billion a month remains to be seen because right now the bond market vigilantes have certainly called his bluff.
segments.zh: 所以这是否有效，我们将在9月9日购买开始时才能知道。贝森特是否把自己逼到了墙角，不得不从每月20亿增加到40亿，甚至可能每月80亿，还有待观察，因为现在债券市场的“义警”肯定已经戳穿了他的虚张声势。

segments.en: What does he have to do to reverse that?
segments.zh: 他需要做什么来扭转局面？

segments.en: I mean, is it more about fiscal consolidation as he mentioned and they really have to address the deficit concerns in order to kind of make this whole bond buying operation actually work?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这是否更多关乎他提到的财政整顿，他们真的必须解决赤字问题，才能让整个债券购买操作真正奏效？

segments.en: Well, speaking as a tax paying American, I certainly hope that we would be addressing the deficit and debt issue in the United States.
segments.zh: 嗯，作为一个纳税的美国人，我当然希望我们能解决美国的赤字和债务问题。
